entries.task_id: do ɖekawawagbɛ|gbé|ɖegbefan yi nu be yewo kando agbetɔ cɛwo ji
entries.description: do ƉEKAWAWAGBƐ gbé ɖegbefan yi nu be yewo kando agbetɔ cɛwo ji
entries.subject: do ƉEKAWAWAGBƐ
entries.object: ɖegbefan yi nu be yewo kando agbetɔ cɛwo ji

spans.text: Sɔsó enyɔ ciwo yi le esewemamɛ wowo ejukɔn ciwo yi do ƉEKAWAWAGBƐ gbé ɖegbefan yi nu be yewo kando agbetɔ cɛwo ji, le amɛnyinyi ko eyi wanawomɛ, lé ŋusuwo kodo nyɔnuwotasɔwɛmɛ, yi yewo sɔ egbe ɖo eju nɔ nɔnɔmɛ, ŋukɔyiyi, nɔ agbemɛnɔnɔ a nyɔ nɔ amɛ kpu, nɔ agbetɔ a kpɔ vovo a wa enu ci yi drwi,

entries.task_id: e sɛnŋu|gbé|ɖɔli sɛ̀nsɛ̀n kodo eyi susu lɔ wo
entries.description: e sɛnŋu gbé ɖɔli sɛ̀nsɛ̀n kodo eyi susu lɔ wo
entries.subject: e sɛnŋu
entries.object: ɖɔli sɛ̀nsɛ̀n kodo eyi susu lɔ wo

spans.text: Amɛɖe kpokpwi ɖo acɛ a vo le enu ci yi druii le eyi tamɛ, ejimɛ ko sɛ̀nsɛ̀n kpaxwe; e sɛnŋu gbé ɖɔli sɛ̀nsɛ̀n kodo eyi susu lɔ wo, alo a ɖe wo to nɔ eju a jeshi; e sɛnnu like nɔ sɛnsɛn ko susu lɔwo a dɔn amɛwo bɔ do eyi ɖeki ŋu sɔ to nukɔyiyi le enukplankplan enuwawa, kodo sɛnsɛn alo sɛnsɛnwanawo pleŋu ŋu.
